safeFieldAllowlist: canonical native parcel ID only if source-proven
full parcel polygon or multipolygon geometry only
native schema field names and field mapping in metadata only
source CRS, query extent, response metadata, and retrieval date
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-15.7146778128923, 46.3433757371013] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No exact-point hit/miss, map extent miss, login wall, unusable UI, or missing anonymous parcel response was treated as evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Public boundary responses were not misclassified as parcels and no raw source-specific attribute sets were retained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS verification exception was used.
Packet completion is research completion only; serial review must independently qualify any real adapter.
